A01.conflict_of_interest: Assessment would be performed by an AI assistant at the user's explicit request, not an independent human rater. This conversation includes prior exposure to model outputs and this assistant's own ratings from a separate 120-item evaluation on port 8766. Stage L involvement cannot be established from the available context (Stage L files are mentioned), so it is marked unsure. No second evaluator's ratings have been accessed or exchanged. The consent checkbox records the user's instruction to participate; it must not be treated as verification of a separate human identity or independent human consent. Coordinator review is required to decide whether AI-generated assessments are eligible for this study.
